## How to check

- [ ] `npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build` pass
- [ ] Tried it in the browser at phone width and desktop width
- [ ] If a tradition rule changed: the source is cited in `sources` and `docs/TRADITIONS.md` was regenerated (`npm run docs:traditions`)
- [ ] If a data service changed: the fetch still works from a browser origin (CORS) and offline packs still load
